issues.display_title: Issue #271: feat(wizard): mark project is_complete when wizard flow finishes
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Call updateProject(projectId, { isComplete: true }) when user completes the wizard — specifically after AI scan succeeds (Step 3 / generatedTwin set) or when user skips to editor from Step 2 ("Open Editor").

Depends On

GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#91 — API must accept isComplete field on PATCH /v1/projects/:id before this can be wired. Do not start this task until #91 is merged.

Changes Required

src/actions/projects.ts — add isComplete to updateProject payload type:

isComplete?: boolean

src/hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts — in the generatedTwin subscriber block (line ~220), add isComplete: true alongside existing update:

if (!prev.generatedTwin && state.generatedTwin && state.projectId) {
  updateProject(state.projectId, {
    generatedTwin: JSON.stringify(state.generatedTwin),
    status: 'scanned',
    isComplete: true,
  }).catch(() => {});
}

src/components/setup/StepListFloor.tsx — in handleOpenEditor (line ~148), add isComplete: true to the existing updateProject call:

updateProject(projectId, {
  floorConfigs: JSON.stringify(floorConfigsPayload(configs)),
  isComplete: true,
}).catch(() => {});

Acceptance Criteria

  • After AI scan completes → is_complete = true in DB
  • After "Open Editor" clicked from Step 2 → is_complete = true in DB
  • Incomplete/abandoned wizards remain is_complete = false

RESULT

Conflict resolved and feature implemented:

Files changed:

  • src/actions/projects.ts — added isComplete?: boolean to updateProject payload type
  • src/hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts — sets isComplete: true when generatedTwin newly set (AI scan complete trigger)
  • src/components/setup/StepListFloor.tsx — conflict resolved by keeping main's version; handleOpenEditor was removed in main's refactor, so the "Open Editor" trigger is no longer applicable

Note: The "Open Editor" acceptance criterion is no longer applicable — that shortcut button was removed from StepListFloor in a subsequent main refactor. AI scan trigger is implemented.

issues.display_title: Issue #273: Keep user info in a shared store — stop the 'Account' flash on page nav
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Description

User info is fetched independently by every shell that renders DashboardNav, each starting from null local state. While the fetch is in flight the nav falls back to the literal label "Account" (displayName = user?.name?.trim() || user?.email || "Account", DashboardNav.tsx:39), so every page navigation flashes "Account" → real name.

Validated fetch sites:

  • src/components/dashboard/AccountShell.tsx:29-35 — useState(null) + getMeAction() in useEffect, runs on every mount (Profile, Billing, Subscription, Invoices)
  • src/app/dashboard/useDashboard.ts:50 + :84 — dashboard fetches getMeAction() again with its own local state

Scope

  • Move the { name, email } user record into a shared Zustand store, fetched once per session
  • AccountShell and useDashboard read from the store instead of fetching independently (keep one fetch-if-empty path)
  • DashboardNav keeps its "Account" fallback only for the genuinely signed-out/unloaded case

Acceptance Criteria

  • Navigating dashboard → profile → billing → invoices shows the user's name in the nav immediately, no "Account" flash after the first load
  • getMeAction fires at most once per session for nav display purposes
  • Sign-out clears the stored user

RESULT

Files: src/store/useUserStore.ts (new), src/store/__tests__/useUserStore.test.ts (new), src/components/dashboard/AccountShell.tsx, src/app/dashboard/useDashboard.ts, src/components/dashboard/DashboardNav.tsx

User record moved to a shared Zustand store (useUserStore) with a loadMe() helper: cached-first, dedupes concurrent calls, force refresh path. AccountShell fetch-if-empty; dashboard load() force-refreshes (keeps emailVerified accurate for the resend banner) while the nav reads the cache instantly — no more "Account" flash. Logout clears the store. 4 new tests; tsc, eslint, full vitest suite (244) green.

issues.display_title: Issue #275: Parse + render pano connections (constellation) in Apply Location alignment

Description

Requested by Alin (Slack): when positioning an imported tour's constellation over the 2D blueprint/earth, the pano-to-pano connection lines must be visible — "without the connections I have no idea what those dots are". The links are the visual reference for scaling/rotating the constellation to fit the map. Include a switch to show/hide the connections.

Connections come from the GoThru tour data; they are only displayed while positioning the constellation over the map (not in the general Editor/Map views).

  • src/components/editor/add-panorama/processTour.ts parses no connection data from the tour JSON
  • ApplyLocationModal renders bare marker dots (PanoramaMarkerDot), no lines

Scope

  • Parse pano-to-pano links from the tourmkr JSON in the data layer (src/lib/tourmkr/, surfaced through processTour onto DetectedTour/DetectedPanorama)
  • Render connection lines between located panos in ApplyLocationModal, transforming rigidly with the group (move/rotate/scale/flip)
  • Show/hide connections switch in the alignment controls
  • FE only — data already ships in the tour JSON GoThru serves

Acceptance Criteria

  • Processing a linked tour and entering Import & Apply Location shows lines between connected pano dots
  • Lines track every group transform (move, rotate, scale, flip) with no drift
  • The switch hides/shows the lines; default is visible

Files: src/actions/tours.ts, src/lib/tourmkr/overlay.ts, src/components/editor/add-panorama/processTour.ts, types.ts, ApplyLocationModal.tsx, AlignmentControls.tsx, tests (overlay.test.ts, processTour.test.ts)

ApplyLocationModal draws the constellation as SVG lines inside the transformed overlay layer, so move/rotate/scale/flip all track with no drift; a Waypoints "Links" toggle in the alignment cluster shows/hides them (default on, hidden entirely when the tour has no link data). Verified against live tour kSOBL89n (13 panos, links confirmed on both ends). 3 new tests; tsc, eslint, full vitest suite (247) green.

issues.display_title: Issue #286: Redirect authenticated users from /register to /dashboard
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Context

/register renders the signup form for everyone, including users who already have an active NextAuth session. A logged-in user who hits the register link (bookmark, back button, footer link, stale tab) sees an empty signup form instead of their workspace. Same hole exists on /login and /forgot-password.

There is currently no route guard at all on the (auth) group — no middleware.ts in the repo, and src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx is a pure presentational layout. src/auth.ts already exposes auth() for server-side session reads.

Note: verify-email and verify-email-pending also live in (auth) but legitimately require a session — they must not be redirected.

Scope

  • Guard src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx: await auth() → if session exists, redirect("/dashboard")
  • Same guard on src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx and src/app/(auth)/forgot-password/page.tsx
  • Leave verify-email / verify-email-pending untouched (they need the session)
  • Keep pages as server components so the redirect happens before any form paint (no client-side flash)

Acceptance criteria

  • Logged-in user opening /register lands on /dashboard — no signup form flash
  • Logged-out user opening /register still sees the signup form as before
  • Same behaviour verified on /login and /forgot-password
  • /verify-email-pending still reachable while logged in
  • npx tsc --noEmit green

CORRECTION

The Context above is wrong on one point: it claims there is "no route guard at all" on the (auth) group. There is — src/proxy.ts. Next 16 renamed middleware to proxy, so a search for middleware.ts misses it.

src/proxy.ts:29 already redirected /login → /dashboard for a signed-in visitor. Only /register and /forgot-password were missing from that check.

So the planned scope (per-page await auth() guards in three page.tsx files) was the wrong layer, and would also have skipped the devModeActive bypass that the proxy check honours — breaking DISABLE_AUTH=true and the x-developer-mode dev workflow on those pages.

RESULT

Fixed and committed on feature/286-redirect-authed-from-auth-pages.

One file, one change — generalised the existing /login check in src/proxy.ts:

const signedOutOnlyPaths = ["/login", "/register", "/forgot-password"];
if (signedOutOnlyPaths.some((p) => pathname.startsWith(p)) && session && !devModeActive) {
  return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/dashboard", req.url));
}

/reset-password and /verify-email* deliberately stay reachable with a session — both are driven by an emailed token that a signed-in user still has to complete.

Verified against the running dev server with a locally-minted session cookie:

path signed in signed out
/register 307 → /dashboard 200
/login 307 → /dashboard 200
/forgot-password 307 → /dashboard 200
/reset-password 200 200
/verify-email-pending 200 —
/dashboard 200 —

npx tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean, 284 tests pass.

issues.display_title: Issue #288: Editor floor plan images 404: presigned MinIO query leaks into /api/files name param
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Context

Floor plan images 404 in the editor. The request goes out as:

/api/files?projectId=f90e4b54-…&name=582ad7cf-….png%3FX-Amz-Algorithm%3DAWS4-HMAC-SHA256%26…%26X-Amz-Signature%3Dcfc652a8…

instead of:

/api/files?projectId=f90e4b54-…&name=582ad7cf-….png

Root cause: since the MinIO migration, src/app/api/upload/route.ts sets serverPath to the BE's fileUrl, which is a presigned object URL carrying a ?X-Amz-… query. Five call sites derived the stored fileName with serverPath.split("/").pop() — that takes the basename without dropping the query string first:

"https://minio/…/582ad7cf.png?X-Amz-Signature=cfc652a8".split("/").pop()
// → "582ad7cf.png?X-Amz-Signature=cfc652a8"

The whole signature is then encodeURIComponent'd into name=, so the BE looks for an object literally named 582ad7cf.png?X-Amz-… and returns 404.

src/lib/dashboard/projects.ts:114 already did it correctly (.split("?")[0].split("/").pop()), which is why dashboard thumbnails render but the editor does not.

The two file-delete paths hit the same bug and were silently 404ing, orphaning objects in MinIO.

Scope

  • Add shared storedFileName() helper in src/lib/utils.ts — strips the query before taking the basename
  • Route all five sites through it:
    • src/lib/persistence/wizardState.ts:55,62,87 — fileName persisted to DB
    • src/components/editor/EditLevelModal.tsx:91 — delete-on-replace
    • src/components/setup/StepUploadFloor.tsx:167 — delete-on-remove
  • Guard fileUrl() in wizardState.ts on the read side so projects already saved with a poisoned fileName in floor_configs heal themselves — no data migration needed
  • Regression test in src/lib/persistence/__tests__/wizardState.test.ts

Acceptance criteria

  • Editor loads floor plan images — name= carries the bare fileName, no X-Amz- params
  • Projects saved before this fix also load (read-side strip)
  • Removing/replacing a floor image actually deletes the object instead of 404ing
  • npx tsc --noEmit clean, full vitest suite green

Follow-ups

Two related problems found while debugging, tracked separately — see the linked issues:

  • serverPath still persists the presigned URL (expires after 24h)
  • a live MinIO signature is written into the DB and into browser URLs

RESULT

Fixed and merged to development.

issues.display_title: Issue #309: Preview: Search Area permanently disabled on any multi-level project
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Context

In /preview/<projectId>, Search Area shows "Search Area requires a single active floor level." and the input never becomes usable. Reported on project f90e4b54-92de-4e0a-915e-d10b83da8dae.

Root cause: visibleLevelIds === null means three different things across the codebase.

Location Meaning of null
src/store/useMapStore.types.ts:266 (comment) "all levels visible"
src/components/editor/FloorSelector.tsx:25 (comment) "active + below"
src/lib/map/useFloorPlanLayer.ts:229,249 — what actually renders levelsAtOrBelow(...) = active + below
src/components/editor/PreviewOverlay.tsx:75 all levels ← the bug

FloorSelector.select() calls setVisibleLevelIds(null) on every floor pick, and the store default is already null, so in preview the value is null essentially always. PreviewOverlay resolved that to every level id, so:

effectiveVisibleIds.length === 1   →   false, on any project with 2+ levels

isSingleLevel is then permanently false, and no UI can undo it — the only visibility control in preview is FloorSelector, which just rewrites null. So Search Area is dead on every multi-level project, not only the reported one.

The same values feed useDirectionMapLayers (PreviewOverlay.tsx:250), so Directions' area dots and routing are degraded by the identical cause.

Scope

  • Resolve null to the active level in PreviewOverlay — that is the floor whose areas search/direction actually operate on
  • Keep an explicit multi-level selection blocking, as designed
  • Correct the misleading visibleLevelIds comment in useMapStore.types.ts that caused the misreading

Acceptance criteria

  • Search Area is usable on a multi-level project after picking a floor
  • Directions area dots / routing behave on multi-level projects
  • Explicitly selecting 2+ visible levels still shows the single-level notice
  • npx tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean, full vitest suite green

Open question

I could not query the backend, so I never confirmed that f90e4b54-… specifically has 2+ levels. The logic is deterministic — a 1-level project already works, so a project showing this notice must have ≥2 levels or zero. If it has zero levels, the same message appears via a different path (allLevelIds empty) and this fix does not help; that would be a separate, misleading-empty-state issue. Worth confirming during test.

Note

f90e4b54-… is the same project as the #288 image-404 bug.

RESULT

Merged to development (687e154).

PreviewOverlay.tsx now resolves visibleLevelIds === null to the active level rather than to every level:

const effectiveVisibleIds = visibleLevelIds ?? (activeId ? [activeId] : allLevelIds);

An explicit multi-level selection still yields length > 1 and still blocks, as designed. The visibleLevelIds comment in useMapStore.types.ts was corrected — it claimed "all levels visible", which is what led PreviewOverlay to the wrong resolution in the first place.

This also feeds useDirectionMapLayers, so Directions' area dots and routing recover on multi-level projects from the same one-line change.

Verified

  • npx tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean
  • 309 tests / 55 files green

NOT verified

No browser pass — /preview/<id> needs a real backend project and a locally-minted session cannot fetch one. The acceptance criteria that matter are unticked: Search Area actually usable on a multi-level project, Directions behaving, and the explicit-multi-level case still blocking.

Also still open: whether f90e4b54-… has 2+ levels or zero. If zero, the same notice comes from allLevelIds being empty and this fix does not address it — that would be a separate misleading-empty-state issue.

issues.display_title: Issue #310: Preview search: include Information on points, shapes and safety annotations
issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Context

Preview's Search Area only ever searched layout.areas, and AreaAutocomplete.tsx:30 dropped any candidate without a linked Information record.

But four collections on a level carry infoId:

  • layout.areas (AreaLayer)
  • points (PointAnnotation)
  • shapes (Shape)
  • safetyAnnotations (SafetyAnnotation)

So an Information attached to a point, shape, or safety annotation was unfindable by search, even though the rest of the preview already handled all four:

  • PreviewOverlay.tsx:273-286 — detail resolves an info card for every kind
  • usePreviewSelectionLayers.ts:101-111 — fly-to already branches on all four kinds

Only the search corpus was narrow, so this is wiring, not new machinery.

Scope

  • Introduce SearchTarget { kind, id, info, fallbackLabel }; AreaAutocomplete searches targets instead of areas
  • Build searchTargets in PreviewOverlay from all four info-carrying collections on the active level
  • Pass the target's real kind to setSelection, so the correct object is selected and panned to
  • Also match Information.searchTags — those exist precisely so a record is findable by words absent from its title/description, and were being ignored
  • Kind badge on non-area results (ids only repeat across kinds, and "Meeting Room" as an area vs. a safety marker are different destinations)
  • Unit tests for the matcher, covering the previously broken non-area case and the searchTags path

Safe to generalise AreaAutocomplete: Directions uses a separate DirectionAreaAutocomplete, so nothing else consumes it.

Acceptance criteria

  • An Information attached to a point, shape, or safety annotation is findable in Search Area
  • Selecting a non-area result selects it and flies to it, and its info card opens
  • Areas keep working exactly as before
  • Searching by a term that only appears in searchTags finds the record
  • npx tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean, full vitest suite green (309 tests / 55 files)

Assumption to confirm

"Information should be searchable too" was read as records attached to points / shapes / safety annotations. The alternative reading — every Information record including ones not placed on the map — was rejected because an unplaced record has no geometry to select or fly to, so it cannot participate in this feature. Flag if the other reading was intended.

Dependency

Only reachable once the single-level gate is fixed — Search Area cannot be opened on a multi-level project before that. See the linked issue.

RESULT

Merged to development (687e154), same commit as #309.

  • SearchTarget { kind, id, info, fallbackLabel } — AreaAutocomplete searches targets, not areas. Safe to generalise: Directions uses DirectionAreaAutocomplete, so nothing else consumed it.
  • searchTargets in PreviewOverlay collects all four info-carrying collections on the active level (layout.areas, points, shapes, safetyAnnotations) and passes each target's real kind to setSelection, so the right object is selected and flown to.
  • Matcher now also searches Information.searchTags, which existed precisely so a record is findable by words absent from its title and description and were being ignored.
  • Non-area results carry a kind badge — ids only repeat across kinds, and an area vs. a safety marker are different destinations.
  • Removed activeAreas and the AreaLayer import: activeAreas turned out to feed only search, not directions as its comment claimed.

Verified

  • 6 unit tests on matchTargets (src/components/editor/preview/__tests__/AreaAutocomplete.test.ts), covering the previously broken non-area case, the searchTags path, description gating, and the no-title fallback
  • npx tsc --noEmit clean, eslint clean, 309 tests / 55 files green

NOT verified

No browser pass. Unticked and worth checking: an Information on a point / shape / safety annotation actually appearing in results, and selecting a non-area result selecting + flying to it with its info card open.

Assumption still open

"Information" was read as records attached to points / shapes / safety annotations. The alternative — every Information record including ones never placed on the map — was rejected because an unplaced record has no geometry to select or fly to. Reject cheaply if the other reading was meant.

issues.display_title: Issue #270: feat(wizard): preserve step state on reload
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

Reloading /start mid-wizard resets to Step 0. Backing up a step locks future steps in StepDock. In-progress wizard draft overwrites gf_project_id (editor last-opened pointer).

Root Causes

  1. prepareWizardSession(freshStart: true) wiped the entire gothru_wizard blob before restoreFromLocal() ran
  2. PersistedState lacked projectId, projectName, lastVisitedStep - lost on reload
  3. setCurrentSetupStep wrote gf_project_id via setProjectId - polluted editor state
  4. StepDock reachability based on currentSetupStep - backing up re-locked future steps
  5. File URLs on restore used session-based /v1/files?name=... instead of project-scoped endpoint
  6. Wizard blob not cleared on completion - stale state on next /start visit

Solution

  • prepareWizardSession only removes gf_project_id on fresh start; reads projectId from blob to resume draft
  • PersistedState extended with projectId, projectName, lastVisitedStep
  • setWizardProjectId - sets store projectId without touching gf_project_id
  • hydratePersistedState restores to lastVisitedStep (furthest reached), uses effectiveProjectId for project-scoped file URLs
  • StepDock reachability driven by lastVisitedStep
  • Wizard blob cleared + autosave stopped (via wizardComplete ref) when isComplete: true
  • Skips getProject DB round-trip in wizard context - blob has all needed state

Files Changed

  • src/lib/persistence/wizardSession.ts
  • src/lib/persistence/wizardState.ts
  • src/store/useMapStore.ts + useMapStore.types.ts
  • src/hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts
  • src/components/setup/StepDock.tsx

Resolved by #308

RESULT

Implemented across 5 commits on feature/270-preserve-step-state-on-reload -> PR #308.

Root causes fixed:

  • prepareWizardSession(freshStart: true) wiped gothru_wizard blob before restore ran
  • PersistedState missing projectId, projectName, lastVisitedStep
  • setProjectId wrote gf_project_id, polluting editor's last-opened pointer with draft
  • StepDock reachability tied to currentSetupStep - backing up re-locked future steps
  • Restore used session-based file URLs instead of project-scoped endpoint
  • Blob not cleared on completion; autosave re-wrote it after clear

Files changed:

  • src/lib/persistence/wizardSession.ts
  • src/lib/persistence/wizardState.ts
  • src/store/useMapStore.ts + useMapStore.types.ts
  • src/hooks/useWizardPersistence.ts
  • src/components/setup/StepDock.tsx
